title: PPPoS (PPP over Serial, e.g. to a GSM/cellular modem)
version: RFC 1662, over a serial modem link
description: Same async HDLC framing as plain PPP, but hardware flow control isn't optional here: the underlying radio/modem can stall mid-transmission, and without RTS/CTS pacing the host will overrun its buffer.

hardwareFlowControlDetails.rtsAssertedMeans: Asserted by the host (DTE): while asserted, permits the module to transmit to the host.
hardwareFlowControlDetails.ctsAssertedMeans: Asserted by the module (DCE): while asserted, permits the host to transmit to the module.
hardwareFlowControlDetails.notes: Assumed for this example -- the classic DTE/DCE modem convention. Real modules vary; state the actual convention when modelling a specific device.
